name: token: late answer written regardless
why: _relLoadRow() writes every live cell of the entity even after a collapse cleared its token, so an emptied column is refilled.
grep: collapsing while a hand-loaded row is still in flight

name: collapse: loading token not cleared
why: The token survives a collapse, so the late answer still matches it and refills the emptied column.
grep: collapsing while a hand-loaded row is still in flight

name: click: no master mirror
why: A hand-loaded row in a multi-table page is written to the live clone only; the next re-render clones a master still carrying its loading token and no icon.
grep: multi-table: a row loaded by hand in a collapsed sub-table

name: delegate: icon-link clicks not ignored
why: Clicking a relationship icon force-reloads the row instead of just following the link.

name: reload: not forced
why: A click on a loaded cell is answered from the L1 cache, so the hover ⟳ reload issues no request.

name: writer: appends instead of replacing
why: Without the textContent clear, a reload appends a second copy of every icon — the multiplying-icons failure mode, now reachable by a user click.

name: setting: click not gated
why: With sa_rel_cell_state_glyphs off the glyphs are gone but a click still loads the row.

name: snapshot: any relDone means expanded
why: The pre-Step-36 default: a reopened sub-table with one hand-loaded row starts expanded and queues a fetch of every other row.
grep: a sub-table carrying only hand-loaded rows

name: writer: no master fallback for a filtered-out row
why: When the clicked row is hidden by a filter mid-flight there is no live cell, and an empty innerHTML is mirrored over the master — the row comes back done with no icon.

name: queue: no loading exclusion (overlap)
why: KNOWN OVERLAP: a queue step reaching a row a click is already loading shares the click's in-flight L1 promise, so no extra request is made and the spec cannot see this. The exclusion saves the step's slot wait and a redundant write. Recorded, not hidden.
